notes:
Inbound free-trial signup (self-serve) from dev lead. Trial started 2026-02-15. Main ask: streaming chat + tool-calling with strict JSON outputs for downstream ingestion.

Summary / context:
- Small engineering org building a conversational assistant for their SaaS help center.
- Want hosted API to avoid infra ops — public cloud only for now.
- Very cost-sensitive but prioritize correctness of structured output (JSON mode) over raw throughput.
- Primary flows: streaming responses to UI + function-calls to internal ticketing tool.

Key technical pain observed:
- During early integration devs see occasional truncated/malformed JSON chunks when using streaming mode; client-side parser fails intermittently.
- Function schema validation on their end rejects responses even when payload looks valid — suspect schema mismatch or trimmed tokens.
- Example from call: "\"items\": [ {\"id\": 123, \"action\": \"create_ticket\" }" (stream ends before closing bracket) — error surface is 'JSONError: Unexpected end of input'.
- When switching to non-streaming (single response) JSON mode, payloads validate consistently but latency spikes; unacceptable UX for chat.

Quotes / paraphrases from call:
- "We need the function call payload to be guaranteed parseable every time; our front-end auto-parses streaming chunks." — dev lead
- "If streaming doesn't give us atomic JSON objects we can't use it." — PM

Integration notes:
- Using JS client on React app, custom streaming decoder on top of fetch readable stream.
- Using function schema with 'create_ticket' and 'update_ticket' signatures. Occasionally the 'name' field missing in partial token streams.
- Latency target: median RTT <400ms for initial tokens; throughput modest (50-100 reqs/min).
- Token budget concerns for long multi-turn contexts; they asked about caching/prefix approaches from Optimize.
